          The team
          Reviewed case memory. Bounded model improvement.
          

          ACE + MLE-STAR · system architecture
          Open the diagram for a larger view.
          

          Case workflow
          From a report to a safeguard
          

          Resolution agent
          Chooses evidence and checks, consults a specialist, and proposes a resolution.
          Proposes · cannot approve
          

          Fraud Analyst
          Reviews the resolution and enables tested safeguards. Auto-approve simulates this role for a demo case.
          Approves · can revoke
          

          Prevention agent
          Turns the reviewed lesson into a candidate safeguard and tests it against lookalikes.
          Proposes · cannot activate
          

          

          Supporting the investigation
          A second look, then validation
          

          Specialists & critic
          Answer one focused question about transactions, identity, scam context, or a proposed resolution.
          

          Harness judges
          Check evidence, detector receipts and unsupported claims before the draft reaches an analyst.
          

          

          Research lab · separate from case handling
          Improve the tools
          

          Risk scientist
          Tests hypotheses and trains bounded candidates using curated examples.
          

          Risk validator
          Checks held-out results and legitimate lookalikes. Candidates still need human release approval.
          

          Shared evidence & data
          Versioned transaction snapshots and reviewed lessons support the team. Active safeguards check payments locally, before debit.
            

            

            

            Restart simulation?
            Start an empty world with 100 residents. Current cases, lessons and safeguards will be archived. Usage limits stay unchanged.
